sculpt_rock_split.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_rock_split.notes: Facet rock (split): exact planes with bevelled edges, beds / joints as geometry, moss cushion as its own primitive (Moss_none). Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, neutral stone ~#9b9b9b; moss its own green). LOD tris 403 / 188 / 67. Origin = foot centre, ~1 m unit; the game fits it into the species box (flora/procgen.js facetRock).
